name: Vacuum extension 100 mm
description: Short hollow extension for the hand vacuum. Front end: a 35 mm push-in plug matching the nozzle opening (41.8 mm wide, one long side flat, the other curved out, 18 mm high at the ends and 20 mm in the middle; 0.2 mm clearance plus two small crush ribs per long side, small lead-in). Back end: a socket of the SAME shape (opening + 0.1 mm per side, small crush ribs inside) for the old brush extension. The old tongue has a slanted end (the rounded side needs 15 mm more depth than the flat side), so the socket floor is slanted the same way: 45 mm deep on the rounded side (the side that stops the old part), 30 mm on the flat side. Straight air channel between. Prints standing on the plug end with the socket opening up, no supports: the socket floor faces up and the shoulder over the plug is a 45 degree chamfer. PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters. The old part's holes/latches are not copied: it holds by friction. Print the two short test pieces first. Not printed or fitted.
